81819.title: In 1927, the Savior wished to build a new local in Norrköping. At the chosen site in the Kapellhorvan district there was an older basement built with a wooden magazine from recent times. This led the Museum of Östergötland to carry out an antiquarian investigation. Ammanuens Bengt Cnattingius describes the basement as erected on the one hand by the split and unworked granite that has been bricked together and trimmed, covered by a barrel vault also made of granite. The mists of the room were 4.25 x 6 m with east-west main direction. As the cellar was not previously judged to have medieval origin, it was acknowledged that it was allowed to be demolished. The picture shows part of the basement facing east.

Extremitățile brațelor crucii sunt de formă rombică iar în centrul ei, pe fiecare parte, se află un cerc având în interior inscripționat, pe avers, litera regelui Ferdinand surmontată de coroană iar pe revers anii 1916-1919. Panglica are alternativ patru dungi albastre și patru verzi iar pe ea se află atașată o baretă îngustă, din alamă ambutisată, cu inscripția 1919.
